scope_notes: Normative annex to FD-INS-02 in the canonical PRODUCT-DESIGN-BRIEF.md. This annex specifies preservation and control contracts, not another final product IA.

User authorized closing the Inspector design-only handoff on 2026-10-16. Parent owns decision authority/readiness in FD-INS-02; this annex does not independently approve engineering or claim runtime correction.

Chosen grouping: persistent target header, Content / Style / Behaviour / Effects; preserve Page appearance and special contexts. Fixed 300px geometry and its validation are governed by the parent panel specification, not changed here.

Exactly one primary disposition per original M07 row; Move rows can depend on Fix contracts. Keep means retain capability/current replacement, never preserve a documented defect. No Restore assigned merely because historical inventory marks a removed interface.

Historical audit evidence remains 97 entry/control/write paths, 19 replacement/absence/reservation checks, 6 downstream partial. Adding design destinations does not deepen that evidence automatically.

Every mapped row invokes IC-13 mutation guards in addition to explicit contracts whenever an authored write is involved; every contextual navigation invokes IC-01. No per-row repetition creates a permission exemption.

All controls include shared draft, error, mixed, reset, history and focus behavior through referenced contracts. Current enum/units not enumerated in a compact row remain source-defined and must be retained; unsupported saved values use Custom rather than default coercion.

The annex maps input semantics, media flags, form transport and other subcontrols explicitly. Full schemas and all backend/runtime integrations are implementation prerequisites, not new product choices or claims of completed testing.

IC-01.title: Identity and navigation
IC-01.owner: Editor session and selection; document names/IDs are separate authored data
IC-01.values: Stable page/object/resource IDs; active tab; section/open state; field focus; scroll; breakpoint/state; canvas pan/zoom; pending draft. No navigation control writes a property.
IC-01.eligibility: Preserve existing destination/role access; exact target must still exist.
IC-01.behavior: Header stays above tabs. Same-task picker/resource return restores pinned context. Deliberate new page/selection supersedes stale return intent. Scope change settles valid edits against original target and preserves/reverts invalid draft explicitly.
IC-01.validation: If target is deleted or permission revoked: “This item is no longer available”; return to valid source/page without assigning elsewhere.
IC-01.commit_reset: Navigation has no document Undo; Rename is a separate authored command with Enter/Escape. Tab/scroll preferences are temporary state, migrated without touching content.
IC-01.keyboard: Tabs use tablist semantics and arrow navigation; Enter/Space activates actions; innermost Escape closes overlay; return focus to invoker; property search reveals exact field.
IC-01.batch: Header uses N selected; ancestor navigation and inspect-one are deliberate selection operations.
IC-01.acceptance: Same-page resource round trip and intentional page switch preserve the right context without stale restoration.

IC-02.title: Style numeric and enumeration fields
IC-02.owner: Selected element style at explicit breakpoint/pseudo state, or permitted instance override; renderer/resolver determines effective value
IC-02.values: Read actual source expression and effective value. Preserve current units and valid custom CSS. Zero, unset, inherited, bound, mixed and invalid draft differ. Slider ranges are convenience ranges unless schema imposes a true limit.
IC-02.eligibility: CSS semantics and actual type/parent context; inherited values can be inspected. All eligible targets identified before write.
IC-02.behavior: Valid typing/scrub uses live updates in one interaction transaction. Enter/blur commits valid draft. Invalid blur retains draft and inline error; navigation prompts Keep editing or Revert only if unmount would lose it. Escape restores interaction-start committed value including any live preview. External change updates unfocused fields; conflicting active draft offers Use latest or Keep editing without silently overwriting.
IC-02.validation: Finite number and property-specific units/ranges; no parseFloat-only acceptance of trailing garbage. Message names accepted value, e.g. “Enter a number from 1 to 60 seconds.” CSS expressions use existing parser validation and Custom representation.
IC-02.commit_reset: Explicit Remove override invokes IC-03; blank input is not automatically Set default. Existing document serialization and sync retained; no Saved until owner confirms. One undo per interaction, separate for mode/preset/reset.
IC-02.keyboard: All labels/units exposed; arrow step respects field; Escape restoration; no drag-only numerical adjustment.
IC-02.batch: Compute mixed per property, read every target, apply declared property set atomically; preserve each target’s companion properties.
IC-02.acceptance: Change/undo/redo/reselect/reopen preserve exact scoped values and interpretation in canvas/preview/output.

IC-03.title: Value source, inheritance and reset
IC-03.owner: Canonical resolver and the exact local/component/reference layer being changed
IC-03.values: Source name, authored expression, effective value, winning breakpoint/state, token/class/component identity and fallback. Unknown remains Unknown, not Default.
IC-03.eligibility: Reset only when target owns corresponding layer and operation is authorized; read-only source inspection remains within existing role access.
IC-03.behavior: Field source details are authoritative. Header provides target/layer orientation, section summary signals active/error counts. Explicit reset names Remove Mobile override / Remove Hover override / Reset instance override / Remove attribute / Unlink token.
IC-03.validation: Fallback is resolved before action; absence of resolution cannot be presented as guaranteed Desktop/default.
IC-03.commit_reset: Remove only named layer/property; Set default writes a value and is different; unlink retains current resolved literal and is different. One transaction with exact Undo; shared definition changes use owner recovery.
IC-03.keyboard: Source indicator has readable button label, focus, keyboard menu; not colour/hover-only.
IC-03.batch: Each selected target removes its own matching layer and resolves its own fallback; never copy primary fallback.
IC-03.acceptance: Desktop48/Tablet32/Mobile unset→32; reset restores actual cascade and does not erase other states/instance overrides.

IC-04.title: Semantic content and attributes
IC-04.owner: Element tag/content/native or custom attributes; wrapper-owned child input where applicable
IC-04.values: Exact DOM semantics; string empty is allowed when meaningful; attribute absence differs from empty and boolean false. Heading H1–H6; numeric attributes require their native/schema constraints; IDs unique per page.
IC-04.eligibility: Actual subtype per field. Text editing is single-target; structural/tag conversion only compatible targets with preserved identity. DOM ID is single-target until a separately specified unique-generation batch exists.
IC-04.behavior: Draft, validation, Enter/Escape and authoritative refresh follow IC-02. Text itself remains canvas edited. Known semantic fields have one primary control; Advanced is not a second competing writer.
IC-04.validation: Name/value syntax checked; reject protected internal attributes; show duplicate ID error without automatic renaming; valid saved custom values are not wiped.
IC-04.commit_reset: Document attrs/content use history; Remove attribute separate from set empty. One Undo restores previous presence/value/tag and references. Normal text edit must not replace child structure.
IC-04.keyboard: Text action focuses exact editable canvas node; select-one explanation and return; native input labels and error association.
IC-04.batch: Mixed/indeterminate field values; same-field compatibility; unsupported subset explicitly counted; never write all from primary display.
IC-04.acceptance: H1+H3 Mixed, mixed Required/Alt accurate, same ID not mass-written, Undo refreshes URL and attribute controls.

IC-05.title: Media and font resources
IC-05.owner: Element assignment/reference versus Assets/font resource owner; library permission is not document write permission
IC-05.values: Existing supported file/MIME/provider/font constraints; source URL/ref; selected font stack; loading/empty/no results/error/missing resource.
IC-05.eligibility: Pin page/element/property/layer and request ID; revalidate exact target, current locks/conflict and access on completion. Do not silently redirect result to current selection.
IC-05.behavior: Open picker→choose→explicit Use/selection commit according to existing picker contract→return origin. Cancel does not assign; uploaded resource may persist independently and must be disclosed. Manage resource opens exact owner with nested Back.
IC-05.validation: Validate accepted type/provider; keep previous assignment on failed load/replacement. Font fallback/loading is not successful desired-font rendering. Conversion of inline SVG to image explicitly states tag/child loss before commit.
IC-05.commit_reset: Assignment uses document history; resource upload/delete uses resource owner recovery. No fake universal Undo for service operations. Retry retains origin/draft and deduplicates request.
IC-05.keyboard: Picker focus and Escape; search states distinguish no results from no library content; restore original field focus.
IC-05.batch: Pickers single-origin by default; intentional identical assignment to explicit compatible batch must preview count and use one transaction.
IC-05.acceptance: Cancel/failure/revoke/delete-target cases cannot assign wrong resource; exact Back; renderer and saved resource agree.

IC-06.title: Forms and structured lists
IC-06.owner: Stable native field/option/slide/column child nodes versus service-owned form delivery settings
IC-06.values: Fields have label content separate from placeholder/name/default; options preserve label/value/selected/disabled/groups; structural lists preserve IDs/order. Columns count derives actual children, Gap derives actual style.
IC-06.eligibility: One structure owner; child and ancestor restrictions rechecked. Per-field primitive batch can follow IC-04. Existing server permission gates retained.
IC-06.behavior: List item selects exact canonical child editor with Back. Add/duplicate/move/delete use existing commands; keyboard Move up/down. Type conversion previews incompatibilities and preserves IDs/styles/attrs/references where valid; if lossless conversion unavailable, require explicit destructive conversion or leave unchanged.
IC-06.validation: Range/date/required feedback local; existing values preserved. Populated-column removal must offer cancellation and supported relocation/preservation before irreversible deletion; do not fabricate storage of hidden children.
IC-06.commit_reset: One history unit per structural operation. Form delivery saves use actual service confirmation, failure/retry and supported compensating restore, not document Ctrl-Z. Existing schemas remain until separate migration review.
IC-06.keyboard: Accessible reorder and selectable list rows; focus follows moved item; delete focuses nearest survivor; errors stay associated.
IC-06.batch: No primary-only child-list task under all-target banner; progress each target reads own max/value.
IC-06.acceptance: Rich form/slide/column fixtures retain IDs/data on edit, Undo/reload and output; delivery failures retain draft and permissions.

IC-07.title: CMS binding and collection source
IC-07.owner: Element binding/query configuration versus CMS schema/record data
IC-07.values: Existing compatible collections/fields, source/limit, static fallback and reference IDs. Future filter/sort/conditions are not assumed implemented.
IC-07.eligibility: Single eligible element/collection-list; field compatibility validated against actual schema; access checked both for CMS read and document write.
IC-07.behavior: Source→compatible field→bind; preview distinguishes loading, empty records, no results, missing collection, deleted/type-changed field and failed fetch. Create/Edit opens exact CMS target and returns to pinned field.
IC-07.validation: “This field no longer exists” versus “Could not load data. Retry”; keep stale reference recoverable, never auto-bind by similar name.
IC-07.commit_reset: Replace binding only after successful validation; Disconnect explicit and names retained static value/fallback. No silent record/schema mutation from binding field. Undo local config; CMS service recovery separate.
IC-07.keyboard: Accessible selects/search/status; Retry and disconnect focus retained; nested resource return obeys IC-01.
IC-07.batch: Single-object binding management; count/inspect-one rather than silently choosing primary.
IC-07.acceptance: Failure/deleted field/type change/late response/revoked rights preserve prior binding and recoverable choice; output empty states agree.

IC-08.title: Component identity and overrides
IC-08.owner: Workspace/library definition/version versus project instance reference and permitted overrides
IC-08.values: Definition ID/version/name, instance identity, variant, override map; local value versus master source. Existing definition manager and Add placement retained.
IC-08.eligibility: Existing instance/definition permissions and plan gates; no workspace sharing/import/export schema invented in Inspector annex.
IC-08.behavior: Persistent identity exposes Edit definition to exact component manager and Back to instance. Local edits only allowed override properties. Variant and Reset explain affected overridden values. Detach states loss of shared linkage.
IC-08.validation: Missing definition/version or incompatible override remains explicit and recoverable, never silently detaches.
IC-08.commit_reset: Local instance override operations follow document history; definition/service edits follow owner-specific persistence/recovery. No promise that ordinary Undo rolls back shared definition publication.
IC-08.keyboard: Identity/action menus and exact Back accessible; restore original instance/tab/field.
IC-08.batch: Management and detach require explicit target selection; primitive override batch requires shared schema/permission intersection.
IC-08.acceptance: Variant/reset/detach/Undo reflect current data without reselection; original content/reference retained where intended; manager return exact.

IC-09.title: Compound effects and visual expressions
IC-09.owner: Local CSS expression at stated style layer; reference tokens retain owner
IC-09.values: Opacity, box-shadow layers, filter function sequence, transform sequence, transitions and advanced CSS; preserve untouched function names, duplicates, argument syntax, order and units.
IC-09.eligibility: Compact controls only when expression can be losslessly edited. Otherwise show Custom value with existing safe raw route or explicit conversion impact, never silently normalize.
IC-09.behavior: Editing one supported term preserves all others; no Map deduplication or canonical-order rewrite. Presets declare full affected expression; unsupported saved expressions remain intact while other fields are edited.
IC-09.validation: CSS-aware parsing; duration nonnegative; valid negative delay preserved where CSS supports; out-of-slider-range valid saved values not clamped on read.
IC-09.commit_reset: Each edit or deliberate conversion one Undo; reset removes property at exact layer and differs from identity expression. Preview-only values cleaned up separately.
IC-09.keyboard: Sliders have numeric alternatives and names/units; custom/conversion confirmation accessible; Escape restores start.
IC-09.batch: Each target expression edited independently, not replaced with primary’s string; whole-preset application explicitly names replacement scope.
IC-09.acceptance: translate3d+rotate, repeated transforms, extended filters, multi-inset shadows and rich gradients round-trip exactly through unrelated edits/Undo/reopen.

IC-10.title: Interactions and animation preview
IC-10.owner: Element trigger interaction records and separate CSS AnimationConfig; runtime engines interpret saved schema
IC-10.values: Preserve current trigger groups and presets/easings from source registry; interaction Duration0.1–10s/Delay0–5s with millisecond storage; CSS animation retains its own supported units/schema. Target/loop/reverse/custom fields preserved even if not edited by compact UI.
IC-10.eligibility: One animation owner; existing trigger support must be proven in runtime before offering a newly inferred capability; legacy saved values shown explicitly.
IC-10.behavior: Add/edit/enable/disable/remove/preview exact record. Preview is transient: snapshot/restore original rendered animation state on stop/selection/tab/unmount; never persist preview DOM overrides. Surface overlapping control of same property without auto-deleting either configuration.
IC-10.validation: Finite timing and supported trigger/preset; missing target or unsupported legacy trigger needs recoverable explanation; no invented timeline/workspace.
IC-10.commit_reset: Document config uses one command per interaction action; clear animation distinct from disabling trigger record. Saved/published proof comes from actual owner operation, not preview playback.
IC-10.keyboard: Preview/Stop and editing fully keyboard accessible; return focus to originating row; no reliance on motion for status.
IC-10.batch: Single-target drill-in; no primary-only editor under all-target promise.
IC-10.acceptance: Preview reset and saved configuration agree in canvas/preview/output; error/selection change leaves no temporary style behind.

IC-11.title: Tokens, classes and shared sources
IC-11.owner: Local token/class references versus Brand/shared definition and actual service permission
IC-11.values: Stable token/class identity; current colour mode; authored var expression; unresolved reference; current font-size token remains a single-property binding. Matching literal does not establish identity.
IC-11.eligibility: Local apply and shared edit have separate rights; resolve current mode and aliases; do not grant authoring where only membership engine is evidenced.
IC-11.behavior: Apply/remove reference locally; Edit source opens exact Brand/class/component owner only where actual route exists. Shared edit explicitly names scope/reach/mode; use same canonical service. Unlink preserves resolved literal; relink pinned to original reference and field.
IC-11.validation: Missing/cyclic/unresolved token remains recoverable; failed shared save keeps draft and Retry; ignored false return must not close with success.
IC-11.commit_reset: Local binding uses document history; shared owner determines persistence/history. Scope names what actually changes. No automatic token creation from matched colour or silent Light-mode write during Dark editing.
IC-11.keyboard: Source chips/buttons named; exact owner/back path; mode included in accessible status.
IC-11.batch: Local primitive binding can apply to compatible targets; shared definition edited once with affected usage summary, never per-selected-element copies.
IC-11.acceptance: Same-valued different tokens retain identity; Dark/Light changes correct mode; local reset/unlink/source edit distinct; classes apply/remove preserve other memberships.

IC-12.title: Page, special and system states
IC-12.owner: Page-root appearance, site Brand preference, AI task, loading/error, editor presentation are distinct owners
IC-12.values: No selection/root→Page appearance; theme-toggle→site-scope readout/Brand door; loading skeleton; render failure; AI takeover; role-denied ViewerRoleNotice; lock/conflict as actual restriction.
IC-12.eligibility: Never replace denied-role notice with full Inspector. Special surfaces keep meaningful target identity and existing permitted routes; no forced tabs that misstate scope.
IC-12.behavior: Preserve page-owned styling and page metadata link; retry does not reset document; AI return uses origin snapshot; errors and draft/save failure distinct. Applicable offline/saving/conflict states derive real services.
IC-12.validation: No fabricated exhaustive review or successful completion. Non-applicable controls absent with explanation where expectation exists.
IC-12.commit_reset: Page styles use document history; site metadata/Brand/AI obey owner contracts; hide/tab/disclosure no document write.
IC-12.keyboard: Focus survives special context transition, Retry and return; status announced once; loading does not focus nonexistent field.
IC-12.batch: Special contexts not multiple-object edit surfaces; explicit selection clearing does not mutate content.
IC-12.acceptance: No selection/page root/theme-toggle/loading/error/AI/Viewer/locked/conflict matrix preserves access and existing useful work.

IC-13.title: Batch actions, guards and recovery
IC-13.owner: Shared command registry/history plus latest resource-specific authorization; UI restrictions are explanatory, not enforcement
IC-13.values: Pinned target IDs, explicit property set/layer, eligible/skipped counts, action impact, pending request identity and actual result.
IC-13.eligibility: Recheck permissions/conflict/locks and target existence at commit, debounced flush, modal submit and async callback; preserve current server rights.
IC-13.behavior: One meaningful transaction for declared batch. Single-target tasks say Select one, or named explicit target drill-in. No blanket all-N promise when handlers only touch primary. Destructive/shared actions summarize actual impact; reversible ordinary edits prefer Undo.
IC-13.validation: No targets or zero source properties produces honest no-op; stale target cannot fall back to current primary. Partial service results reported and retried only where unresolved.
IC-13.commit_reset: Engine mutations/history safety required beyond disabled controls. Document Undo affects exactly recorded targets/properties; server actions use supported compensating recovery; failure never reports successful save.
IC-13.keyboard: Actions and menu/confirmation accessible; focus returns after cancel; input Undo stays in draft where appropriate.
IC-13.batch: Read per-target source/companion values; atomic compatible operation or explicit skip summary; IDs and structural children need stricter eligibility.
IC-13.acceptance: Mid-operation lock/conflict/revoke/delete and mixed targets cannot produce hidden writes; Undo/Redo maintains every original value/reference.
